title: QuantBot Algo Review 2026: Legit or Scam?
description: QuantBot Algo review: what its site says about strategy files, the Darwinex track record and pricing tiers, and what to verify before you buy.
author: Daniel Carter
excerpt: QuantBot Algo sells strategy files backed by a Darwinex track record, but its return figures lack a stated method.
content:
QuantBot Algo is an algorithmic trading service run by Codevoai FZC LLC, a company the site places in Sharjah, UAE. It sells downloadable strategy files, an AI trading mentor and a free tier. The headline claim is a +51.02% return over two years, which the site says can be checked on Darwinex.

QuantBot Algo at a Glance

Here is what the source page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the source says
OperatorCodevoai FZC LLC (Sharjah, UAE). A company licence number is shown, but no financial regulator
StrategiesDownloadable strategy files built with a proprietary method; 14 robustness tests claimed
PricingFree, Trader and Master tiers. No prices listed on the homepage
Minimum depositNot stated on the site; strategies run on the user's own broker
Track record+51.02% over two years, +22.89% annualised, $470,032 investor capital, 14 investors
SupportEmail, social channels and an AI mentor advertised 24/7
Affiliate disclosureNone found on the site

Items come from the reference page and the official site where we checked them. We have not tested the product.

Is QuantBot Algo Legit? What the Claims Show

Strategy files and robustness tests

The site says each strategy passes 14 robustness tests and was backtested over more than 500,000 trades. It does not describe the strategies, their logic or their risk limits, so a buyer cannot judge what the files actually do.

The Darwinex track record

The return figures are tied to a Darwinex Zero account before the firm moved to live capital. The site does not say which figures are virtual and which are live, how fees were treated, or what the "5+ years" testing period refers to. These are the first things to check on Darwinex directly.

Pricing tiers

The site lists Free, Trader and Master tiers but no prices on the page. Ask for the full price list and renewal terms in writing before paying.

QuantBot Algo Costs and Pricing

The site lists no prices, minimum deposit or payment methods on the page. Strategy files run on a broker you choose, so broker spreads and commissions are extra. Read the price and refund terms before you buy.

Our standard minimum deposit for this review is 250 in the reader's local currency. The site does not state a deposit figure, so ask the operator which amount applies to you.

Who Is Behind QuantBot Algo

The site names a company and a licence number but no financial regulator. The track record cannot be linked to an independent audit on the page. Its risk disclaimers say past performance does not predict future results, which is a useful minimum.

Before You Buy: A Short Checklist

  • Look up Codevoai FZC LLC and its licence number in the company registry where it is based.
  • Open the Darwinex track record yourself and check which figures are live and which are virtual.
  • Ask for the full price list, renewal terms and refund policy in writing.
  • Run any strategy file on a demo account before you use real money.

Risks to Keep in Mind

Strategy files built on backtests can fail in live markets, and the site itself says so. A track record on one account over a short window says little about future results. Leverage and broker costs can change the outcome more than the strategy does.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is QuantBot Algo legit?

The site names a company and a licence number, but it names no financial regulator. Check the company registry and the Darwinex record before you pay.

How much does QuantBot Algo cost?

The site lists Free, Trader and Master tiers but no prices on the page. Ask for the price list in writing.

Is the QuantBot Algo track record real?

The site ties its figures to Darwinex, which you can check yourself. The site does not say which numbers are live and which are virtual.

Does QuantBot Algo have a minimum deposit?

The site does not state one. Strategy files run on your own broker, so confirm the broker's minimum and your own costs.

Can automation remove the risk of losing money?

No. Strategy files change how trades are placed, not whether they can lose money.

Our Verdict on QuantBot Algo

QuantBot Algo gives a clear claim, a named company and a track record you can check, which is more than many sites in this category offer. The strategy details and prices are still missing from the page, so check the Darwinex record and the company registry before buying. Our rating reflects these gaps. We will revisit it once the details above are confirmed.
